thread:
laura_pm: quick debrief from this morning's release — we need to lock the next micro-iteration scope. main tradeoff: fix a set of high-impact bugs vs. rolling a couple UX enhancements customers asked for.

omar_eng: can you share the bug heatmap? I want to see which ones hit error budgets or are customer-blocking.

sasha_cs: pasted a short summary in the ticket: 7 total customer-reported issues in the first 48h. 2 are login/edge-case crashes (sev 1 for the affected customers), 3 are confusing UX flows, 2 are low-severity cosmetic.

jia_design: the UX asks are: 1) clearer empty-state copy, 2) nicer inline validation in the form, 3) smaller layout tweak on mobile. None require backend changes, mostly frontend + copy.

omar_eng: good — the two crash bugs need immediate attention. Ben, any SRE signal on whether those are rollout-induced?

ben_sre: deploy-bot flagged a spike in 503s at 01:12 UTC but it correlated with a particular tenant's traffic pattern. Root cause looks like a rare kv-cache miss path leading to an unhandled exception. We're throttling affected host as a temporary mitigation.

deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-192 (kv-cache-unhandled-exception). Assigned to @omar_eng.

omar_eng: taking INC-2026-192 now. ETA for patch & canary rollback window: 3 hours if no other downstream problems.

laura_pm: proposal: prioritize the two crash fixes into a hotpatch (ship within 24h), then for the next weeklong micro-iteration pick up the two highest-impact UX enhancements (empty-state copy + inline validation). Cosmetic items move to backlog. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

sasha_cs: +1 from CS — those UX changes will reduce support volume and are quick wins. Customers who complained are fine with a short hotpatch now.

jia_design: can deliver copy + validation mocks by EOD today. dev effort estimate: ~2 dev-days total across frontend owners.

omar_eng: agree to hotpatch for crashes. After hotpatch, we should run a focused canary on the tenant that triggered the 503s for 24h. For the UX work, we can slot it into the sprint after the hotpatch — low risk.

ben_sre: also recommend adding a small regression test for the kv-cache path to CI so we don't get surprised after rollouts. I can sketch the test in the next 24h.

laura_pm: actions then: 1) omar -> hotpatch crash fix + canary (INC-2026-192). 2) ben -> regression test PR. 3) jia -> deliver mocks and copy. 4) laura -> update release notes and customer comms draft. 5) sasha -> prioritize CS outreach post-hotpatch.

laura_pm: acceptance criteria for hotpatch: reproducer coverage + successful canary on affected tenant for 24h + zero increase in 5xxs across other tenants.

omar_eng: will update thread with PR link and canary status. planning to roll within 3h.

sasha_cs: i'll prepare a short CS template to send to impacted customers once hotpatch confirms.

jia_design: uploading copy mock in the ticket now.

laura_pm: thanks all — good balance of reliability-first + quick UX wins. we'll re-evaluate backlog cut next Thursday. :thumbsup:
